inbox_review.scope: Reviewed the complete project inbox and provisional shortlist. Direct primary-source review promoted the signed MCP v2.1.0 security release over automated model-pricing and new-repository leads.

archive_review: Reviewed all 19 episode files and confirmed publication receipts through October 22. Episode 2026-10-12-mcp-reference-servers covered the v1.0 reference packages and educational boundary, not the v2.1.0 fixes, affected versions or explicit date-version upgrade requirement.

openai.reason: The October 22 Decisions API GA adds JSON input, question-specific images, shared-input caching and 400 questions. It materially extends prior beta coverage but needs its own migration and evaluation.

anthropic.reason: Anthropic-managed Claude on Google Cloud launched October 22 with Marketplace billing and IAM access; its separate organization and service setup require a focused integration briefing.

google.reason: No official Gemini API entry is newer than the October 13 Gemini 4 Argon release, already covered by episode 2026-10-15-gemini-argon-api.

repositories.reason: The October 25 signed v2.1.0 release fixes eight vulnerabilities in Filesystem, Everything and Fetch, with exact patched versions and an explicit upgrade path.

architectures.reason: SPECMEM is a research-only live tool-call memory architecture with side-effect gating and reported open-model results; it needs a dedicated full-paper review.

candidates.title: MCP reference servers v2.1.0 security update
candidates.summary: v2.1.0 fixes eight vulnerabilities across Filesystem, Everything and Fetch. The fixed packages are Filesystem 2.0.1, Everything 2.0.1 and Fetch 2026.10.24.
candidates.availability: Patched packages are published on npm and PyPI. Filesystem remains partly exposed to a junction race on Windows under the advisory's conditions.
candidates.practical_use: Inventory configured MCP reference servers, explicitly install fixed versions, restart clients and re-check directory, origin and network boundaries.

source_review.excerpt: v2.1.0 fixes eight vulnerabilities in three servers.
source_review.decision: Signed release, package table, repository warning and linked Filesystem advisory reviewed. Claims stay within documented fixes and limits.
source_review.availability: Filesystem and Everything 2.0.1 are on npm; Fetch 2026.10.24 is on PyPI.

candidates.title: OpenAI Decisions API generally available
candidates.summary: The Decisions API reached GA with structured JSON evidence, per-question images, prompt caching and up to 400 questions per request.
candidates.availability: Generally available through POST /v1/decisions with gpt-6-luna, subject to API access and regional conditions.
candidates.practical_use: Migrate a beta routing evaluation to JSON evidence and compare thresholds and cached-input usage on a labeled set.

source_review.excerpt: The Decisions API is now generally available.
source_review.decision: Changelog and exact GA guide reviewed; deferred because the material delta deserves a separate evaluation beyond the earlier beta episode.

candidates.title: Claude Models on Google Cloud, Anthropic managed
candidates.summary: Anthropic now operates the Claude API through Google Cloud projects with Marketplace billing and project-level IAM roles.
candidates.availability: Requires Marketplace purchase permission, service enablement, a new Anthropic organization and Google Cloud IAM roles.
candidates.practical_use: Plan a project-scoped Claude integration with service accounts and explicit IAM roles without assuming an existing Anthropic organization carries over.

source_review.excerpt: Google Cloud handles access and billing for Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed).
source_review.decision: Release note and setup guide reviewed; deferred for a focused cloud integration story.
source_review.availability: Available through Google Cloud Marketplace with documented project and organization setup.

candidates.title: SPECMEM live tool-call memory
candidates.summary: SPECMEM proposes bounded per-user stores of verified tool calls, online LRU updates and a side-effect gate before irreversible calls.
candidates.availability: Research paper; production availability was not established in this review.
candidates.practical_use: Compare live per-user call memory with a frozen store while separately auditing irreversible side effects and cross-user leakage.

source_review.excerpt: verified calls are written back online into bounded per-user stores with LRU eviction
source_review.decision: Abstract, submission history and reported results reviewed; deferred as research-only pending full-paper analysis.

editorial_decisions.candidate: MCP reference servers v2.1.0 security update
editorial_decisions.reason: Fresh, signed, shipped and immediately actionable, with exact affected and fixed versions plus a material delta from the October 12 episode.
Material GA delta from beta, but it needs a separate evaluation rather than crowding a repository upgrade briefing.
Useful cloud access change that needs its own IAM, billing and organization-boundary explanation.
Research-only architecture requiring a full-paper Deep review.
